decision_conditions: The proposed change of use from a single family dwellinghouse (Use Class C3) to a small House in Multiple Occupation (Use Class C4) fails to accord with Schedule 2, Part 3, Class L of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended) as there is an Article 4 Direction in place which removes permitted development rights for changes of use from Class C3 to Class C4. As such, the development requires planning permission. In the absence of planning permission, the proposal is unacceptable and is therefore refused.

The proposed single storey rear extension does not constitute permitted development by virtue of the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A, provisions A.1 (f)(i) and A.1 (i) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015. The proposal is not permitted development as the enlarged part of the dwelling house would extend beyond the rear of the original house by more than 3 metres and the height of the eaves of the enlarged part would exceed 3 metres within 2 metres of the boundary of the curtilage of the dwellinghouse. Accordingly, the application is refused and planning permission would be required.

In dealing with the application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive way. We have informed the applicant of the changes implemented by the introduction of the Article 4 in December 2025, and offered the opportunity for withdrawal and a full refund of the fee. As this was not accepted by the applicant the Council is left in no position but to refuse this proposed certificate of lawful development in line with the requirements of the Article 4 Directions in place at the time of determination and the other reasons for refusal stated above.
description: Change of use from Class C3 (Dwellinghouse) to Class C4 (Small Scale HMO), along with the erection of a single storey rear extension (Application for a Certificate of Lawful Development for a Proposed Development)
